name: Lylanar

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: What've we got here? An audience?
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Bloodsport Arena:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Fresh challengers more like.
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Bloodsport Arena:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Shame the usual crowd isn't here to watch us slaughter them.
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Bloodsport Arena:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Their screams will have to substitute for cheering.
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Bloodsport Arena:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Let's put on a show!
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Bloodsport Arena:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Gloves off then, if that's how you want it.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: I think they want the title, Turli. Let's show them why we're the champs.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Care to wager how long they last?

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: I wager half will be dead before three beats of a drum.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: We've won hundreds of battles, but this may be the first time we win a staring contest.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Maybe they where just here to watch.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Should we toss a few more thralls to the wolves while we wait?

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Now there's a proper brawl!

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Had your warm up then?
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the first wave of wolves:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Think you can fight fire with fire?

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: You can't handle that power.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Trying to borrow my power won't bring you vicotry.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: You'll go up like tinder now.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: I'll be taking that back now.
dialogue.trigger: Lylanar taking the Destructive Ember in Charring Constriction (Hard Mode only):

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: You're primed to explode.
dialogue.trigger: Lylanar taking the Destructive Ember in Charring Constriction (Hard Mode only):

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Watch me Turli, this is how it's done.
dialogue.trigger: If he's the first one to face:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: My iron friend always puts on a good show.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Bury them in molten iron!

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Iron and fire are my allies!

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Avenge me!
dialogue.trigger: Summoning Iron Atronarch to aid Turlassil (Hard Mode only):

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: This should heat the battle up a bit!
dialogue.trigger: Summoning Iron Atronarch to aid Turlassil (Hard Mode only):

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Try my iron sparring partner on for size.
dialogue.trigger: Summoning Iron Atronarch to aid Turlassil (Hard Mode only):

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: You can't take the heat.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: You look ready to torch.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: My hounds will sear your flesh.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Come forth, hounds!

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Have some helpers, no need to thank me, Turli.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: The power of flame breathes life into my hounds!

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Clip their wings for me, Turli! I'll handle the rest.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Anything for my dear brother.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: I don't wish to hog all the excitement. Turli, why don't you get in on the action?

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: I'm always cleaning up after you Ly.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Boooring! I'll add to the side show.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: You're stronger than you look, but this ends now! Slow them down, Turli.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: It warms me to feed needed.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: I don't wish to hog all the excitement. Turli, why don't you get in on the action?

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: I just need to catch my breath. Besides, you looked bored hiding up there.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Keep these rats from nipping at my heels for a moment Ly.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: I thought you'd never ask.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: That was a limp performance, Turli. I'll show them what true power is.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: You'll be crying for my help soon enough.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: I don't want to finish them off before you get a crack at them, Ly.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Allow me to demonstrate what winning looks like.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Make good use of this warm up. You'll need it.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Watch me, Turli. This is how it's done!

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: I may be down, but not out!

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: One good spark should set you off.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Come on, Turli, lets secure the victory.
dialogue.trigger: When both brothers are out in the arena:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Fine, but I lead the card on our next bout.
dialogue.trigger: When both brothers are out in the arena:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: It would seem my bad luck has rubbed off on you, Ly.
dialogue.trigger: When both brothers are out in the arena:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Enough heckling from the stands! Let's put an end to this together.
dialogue.trigger: When both brothers are out in the arena:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: If you're done sulking, Ly, some assistance would be welcome.
dialogue.trigger: When both brothers are out in the arena:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Fine, but only because I love to hear you beg for my help.
dialogue.trigger: When both brothers are out in the arena:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Now, Ly!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: A duet of death!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Join me, brother!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Combined might!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: In perfect concert!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Let's finish this!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: It's time, brother!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: A bond unrivaled!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Together now!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: That's teamwork.
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Let's team up a while
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Let's finish this!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: I feel bad adding that win to our record.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Unskilled and soft.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Glad no one had to watch that pathetic display.
"This is defeat? I... hate it."

summary: Lylanar (or Ly) is an orange scaled Maormer found in Dreadsail Reef. He is the twin brother of Turlassil and both serve as the first boss of the trial.
